method.shard_metadata: Hugging Face repository metadata queried at the pinned commit; every edu_high Parquet file is included.
method.row_group_metadata: Parquet footers read by HTTP range requests.
method.subset_identification: Exact min=max subset statistics used directly; only row groups with mixed or ambiguous subset statistics had the subset column read.
method.source_column_followup: The source column was read only for row groups containing dolly_15k, legal_pt, or roots to identify upstream provenance; document text was not read.
